question: SEO stands for ____________.
explanation: SEO stands for Search Engine Optimization.

question: SEO is a subset of ____________.
explanation: SEO is considered a subset of Search Engine Marketing (SEM).

question: SEO is useful in ____________ the number of visitors to a website.
explanation: SEO optimizes pages to increase organic visitor traffic.

question: ____________ is an online program or software that helps users to search for information on the World Wide Web.
explanation: Search engines index the web to answer textual queries.

question: ____________ is concerned with Website-Website relationship.
explanation: Off-Page SEO focuses on external link relationships and backlinks.

question: ____________ is concerned with information that is displayed to the end user.
explanation: On-Page SEO handles visible content, headings, and page structure.

question: ____________ includes provision of good content, good keywords selection, etc.
explanation: On-Page optimization deals with keywords and content quality.

question: ____________ includes link building, search link exchange, etc.
explanation: Off-Page SEO deals with external link generation.

question: ____________ strategies include relevant content and good design.
explanation: White Hat SEO adheres ethically to search engine guidelines.

question: ____________ strategies include duplicate and stolen content.
explanation: Black Hat SEO uses deceptive techniques like duplicate content.

question: ____________ is associated with White Hat SEO.
explanation: Providing proper alt attributes and labels is a White Hat best practice.

question: If it is a singular tag, e.g. , it should be self-enclosed like ____________.
explanation: Self-enclosing tags in strict standard-compliant HTML use `<img/>`.

question: Title contents should be up to ____________ characters (spaces included).
explanation: Search engines typically show up to 60 characters for page titles.

question: Meta description should be between ____________ characters.
explanation: Meta descriptions are optimized when kept between 70 and 160 characters.

question: The ____________ attribute of the tag gives information about the image.
explanation: The alt attribute provides alternative text for screen readers and SEO.

question: ____________ are important words and phrases related to the developed website content.
explanation: Keywords are central queries targeted by search optimization.

question: ____________ is a powerful tool in promoting a website and creating quality backlinks.
explanation: Social bookmarking platforms allow saving and sharing high-authority links.

question: ____________ are website links that are stored for future references.
explanation: Bookmarks store destination web links for quick retrieval.

question: SMO stands for ____________.
explanation: SMO stands for Social Media Optimization.

question: ____________ deals with enhancing website ranking using interactive communities like Facebook and Twitter.
explanation: Social Media Optimization promotes engagement across social networks.

question: ____________ are links on one website that, when clicked, take the user to another site.
explanation: Backlinks direct users and search spiders to destination websites.

question: Backlinks represent a 'vote of confidence' from one site to another.
explanation: Search engines evaluate inbound backlinks as authority indicators.

question: The ____________ file tells search engines which pages you want to exclude from indexing.
explanation: robots.txt sets crawling directives for web spiders.

question: An SEO Audit analyzes a website's ____________.
explanation: An audit assesses compliance and overall site health.

question: An ____________ helps to find out what could be done to improve ranking on search engines.
explanation: An SEO audit provides diagnostic recommendations.

question: ____________ is a free SEO audit tool that performs detailed SEO analysis.
explanation: SEOptimer is a widely referenced free web SEO analysis tool.

question: SEO is a technique used for ____________ and ____________ a website to rank high in search engines:
explanation: SEO influences both frontend design and backend development structure.

question: Select TWO primary types of SEO:
explanation: The two foundational classifications of SEO are On-Page and Off-Page.

question: Techniques of SEO are classified into ____________ and ____________:
explanation: SEO implementation techniques are split into White Hat and Black Hat.

question: Page content optimization can be done by using keywords in which TWO HTML tags?
explanation: <title> and <meta> tags are key on-page keyword placement zones.

question: Select TWO additional factors that help rank a website higher:
explanation: Fast loading times and a valid robots.txt file improve search engine ranking performance.

question: Social Media Optimization deals with enhancing site ranking using interactive communities like ____________ and ____________:
explanation: Blogs and Facebook are interactive community spaces used in SMO.

question: Meta description tags should be between ____________ and ____________ characters:
explanation: Textbook specifications recommend a length between 70 and 160 characters.

question: A web page should include proper heading tags from ____________ to ____________ wherever required:
explanation: Headings in HTML follow the hierarchy from <h1> through <h6>.

question: Keyword ____________ and ____________ are important parts of Search Engine Optimization:
explanation: Keyword Research and Keyword Analysis form the core of keyword planning.

question: Select TWO online Keyword Planner tools:
explanation: Google AdWords (Google Ads) and Keyword Planner provide search volume analysis.

question: Select TWO key technical factors that affect SEO:
explanation: Fast page loading and responsive mobile layouts are critical ranking criteria.

question: On-Page SEO includes which THREE of the following?
explanation: Good content, relevant keywords, and strategic keyword placement are essential On-Page factors.

question: Off-Page SEO includes which THREE of the following?
explanation: Link building, link exchange, and directory submission are core Off-Page activities.

question: On-Page SEO is concerned with information displayed to the end user, such as which THREE?
explanation: On-Page factors focus on user-facing elements like text, images, and intuitive site navigation.

question: Select THREE popular examples of search engines:
explanation: Google, Yahoo, and Bing are prominent web search engines.

question: Black Hat strategies include which THREE practices?
explanation: Duplicate content, hidden/invisible text, and keyword stuffing are Black Hat practices.

question: White Hat strategies include which THREE practices?
explanation: Relevant text, well-labeled images, and organic links are White Hat best practices.

question: SEO stands for Search Engine _____.
explanation: SEO stands for Search Engine Optimization.

question: The file named _____ instructs search engine crawlers which pages or files not to crawl.
explanation: robots.txt contains instructions on disallowed URLs for search engine robots.

question: In On-Page SEO, the _____ attribute of the img tag provides alternative text for screen readers and search bots.
explanation: The alt attribute describes the image content to search engines and visually impaired users.

question: A _____ sitemap provides a roadmap of website URLs formatted specifically for search engine web crawlers.
explanation: An XML sitemap helps crawlers discover and index all valid URLs on a website.

question: Techniques that follow search engine guidelines to improve organic rankings are called _____ Hat SEO.
explanation: White Hat SEO adheres strictly to search engine webmaster quality guidelines.

question: Deceptive techniques such as keyword stuffing and invisible text are known as _____ Hat SEO.
explanation: Black Hat SEO uses manipulative tactics that violate search engine policies.

question: In HTML, the meta tag with name='_____' describes the overall summary of the webpage content.
explanation: The meta description summarises the page snippet in search engine results pages (SERPs).

question: SERP stands for Search Engine _____ Pages.
explanation: SERP stands for Search Engine Results Pages.

question: Off-Page SEO includes activities carried out directly on your own website code and content.
explanation: Off-Page SEO involves external signals like backlinks and social shares.

question: Keyword stuffing is considered a legitimate White Hat SEO practice.
explanation: Keyword stuffing is a manipulative Black Hat tactic penalized by search engines.

question: High-quality inbound links (backlinks) from authoritative websites improve a site's search ranking.
explanation: Backlinks serve as votes of confidence, increasing domain authority and trust.

question: The title tag is an essential On-Page SEO element placed inside the head section.
explanation: The title tag is displayed in browser tabs and as the clickable headline on SERPs.

question: A slow page loading speed can negatively impact a website's search engine ranking.
explanation: Page speed is a confirmed ranking factor in modern search engine algorithms.

question: Google Analytics and Google Search Console are tools used to monitor website performance and indexing.
explanation: These tools track traffic, crawl errors, click-through rates, and query impressions.

question: Which of the following is an example of an On-Page SEO factor?
explanation: Meta tag optimization occurs directly within the HTML source code of the webpage.

question: Which file is placed in the root directory to guide search engine spiders on crawl rules?
explanation: robots.txt sits at the domain root (example.com/robots.txt) to communicate with crawlers.

question: Which Black Hat technique involves displaying different content to search engines than to human visitors?
explanation: Cloaking serves one version of a page to crawlers and another to regular users.

question: Which metric measures the percentage of visitors who leave a site after viewing only one single page?
explanation: Bounce rate represents single-page visits with no interaction on the page.

question: Select TWO primary classifications of Search Engine Optimization techniques:
explanation: SEO is broadly divided into On-Page (site factors) and Off-Page (external signals).

question: Select TWO unethical Black Hat SEO techniques:
explanation: Keyword stuffing and doorway pages are deceptive Black Hat tactics.

question: Select TWO essential HTML tags used for On-Page optimization:
explanation: The <title> tag and <meta> tags directly communicate page subject matter to search engines.

question: Select TWO major types of website sitemaps:
explanation: XML sitemaps cater to search engine bots, while HTML sitemaps aid human visitors.

question: Select THREE valid White Hat SEO practices:
explanation: Quality content, responsiveness, and performance are standard White Hat guidelines.

question: Select THREE factors that influence technical SEO ranking:
explanation: SSL, mobile friendliness, and Core Web Vitals (speed) are core technical SEO signals.

question: Match the SEO terms with their definitions:
explanation: Associates each SEO methodology with its standard textbook definition.

question: Match the technical files and metrics with their function:

pairs.right: Lists site URLs for index discovery

explanation: Pairs technical SEO files and key engagement analytics with their roles.
